applicability: Task-document body projection with optional external direct-grant annotation.
conditions: Canonical reads are addressed by the requested document, graph-named masters and explicit children, or owning master and explicit file-bearing task rows.
Grant records use the per-task addressed census.
exclusions: Legacy unaddressed grant fallback may inspect other retained grant records; it is outside the former zero-directory-I/O promise.
Concurrent browser requests and always-on corpus projections have separate costs.
statement: A task-document body read avoids canonical task-corpus enumeration: it opens the requested document, graph-named masters and their explicitly listed child documents for graph annotation, and the owning master with its explicit task files for ordinary dependency facts. It separately reads task-addressed direct-grant records; retained legacy unaddressed grants use their explicit fallback, not a constant-I/O guarantee.
